scenarios.name: GistOwnCases-Verbatim
scenarios.checks: The gist's own 12 cases, unmodified, node v24.22.2: same purchase/shared owner -> delivered+held signer=1; isolated owners (negative control, independent fence roots — the gist's own caveat model) -> 2 delivered signer=2; different purchase IDs -> 2 signer=2; same ID different payer accounts -> 2 signer=2; same ID changed input -> conflict+delivered signer=1; same ID changed terms (amount 1001 vs 1000) -> conflict+delivered signer=1; lost reply after signed submission -> unresolved (x402 #4094 boundary class, recorded not judged) and the later process still refuses ('held', signer=0); pre-sign failure -> 'fenced' and later process does not guess it is safe ('held', signer=0); native cap refuses BEFORE reservation ('cap-refused', signer=0) and the over-cap offer did not reserve (later process delivered) — the reservation is not consumed by a refused offer. Exit 0; candidate's own counters total 11 sign calls

scenarios.name: AsyncLocalStorage-Glue-Preflight-UNSEALED
scenarios.checks: UNSEALED dry-run: CONCURRENCY=2 race with distinct purchase_ids — each slot carried its OWN (account, purchaseId) into reserve() under the race (sidecar cross-check sidecar_accounts_ok=true, count equality); signer=2, delta 9 ms, both calls before any slot completed; harness-glue validation only, not a matrix row

scenarios.name: IdenticalOfferRace-SharedAccount-Dedup
scenarios.checks: Identical concurrent offers (10000,10000), same account string, same purchase_id, one fence root, both modes: exactly ONE signed payment per mode (signer=1, committed=1, winner verbatim 10000); the concurrent duplicate is rejected PRE-SIGNER with the candidate's own decision 'held' (same intent already reserved — sidecar logged decision=held on the identical intent digest); rejected slot carries presign_decide=rejected + slot_error and ZERO signer calls (attribution consistent in both modes); link() atomicity arbitrates the race — first reservation wins, the loser never reaches the signer

scenarios.name: SeparateAccounts-SamePurchaseId-NegativeControl
scenarios.checks: Boundary negative control, both modes: DISTINCT account strings with the SAME purchase_id through one fence root — the fence key digest([account, purchaseId]) does not collide across accounts: signer=2, committed=2, zero rejections (deltas 8/10 ms), behavior unchanged; scope per pre-registration: distinct owner STRINGS, single shared filesystem root (the reference owner per the gist's own model); cross-process/independent-roots is the gist's own Layer-1 negative control and is out of scope for the lab matrix

scenarios.name: DistinctPurchases-IdenticalQuote
scenarios.checks: Different purchase_ids over an IDENTICAL quote (10000,10000 — identical intent digest on both keys), shared account, both modes: reservations independent — signer=2, committed=2, zero rejections; no over-blocking of legitimate concurrent purchases

scenarios.name: ConflictingOfferRace-ChangedIntent
scenarios.checks: Same purchase_id, CONFLICTING intents (10000,100000 — stand serves the raised offer to one slot), race, both modes: exactly 1 commitment + exactly 1 PRE-SIGNER rejection per mode (signer=1 per mode); the conflict is the candidate's own 'conflict' decision (intent digests diverge on the same fence key, verbatim in the sidecar log: A10a reserved 914414b9… vs conflict 6367c7ba…; A10b reserved 830aa107… vs conflict 8fcbb474…); 0 additional signatures after the first commitment. Winner-agnostic (matchers never assert WHICH slot won; winner recorded verbatim: A10a slot1 10000, A10b slot1 10000). The candidate client carries no expectedAmount quote-control (R3-equivalent), so this row doubles as the conflicting-offer control C for BOTH modes: 1 commitment + 1 pre-signer rejection holds in both

scenarios.name: ConflictingOffers-DistinctPurchaseIds-Supplementary
scenarios.checks: SUPPLEMENTARY probe, config-dependent expectation (pre-registered): conflicting offers (10000 vs 100000) under DISTINCT purchase_ids — signer=2, committed=2, zero rejections in both modes (distinct intent digests on distinct keys). Under the candidate's fence-only configuration this is the CORRECT behavior; the baseline quote-control harness would yield signer=1 here — configuration fact, NOT a regression

findings_summary.title: Configuration facts recorded per pre-registration addendum R3: (a) NO expectedAmount quote-control in the lab client (the fence digests the canonical intent — expectation-independent semantics); (b) native spendControls ENABLED but NON-TRIGGERING: the gist's own client sets allowedAssets maxAmountPerPayment '2000' at its own fixture scale; scaled to '1000000' for the lab stand's atomic amounts — the cap-refusal class (refusal must precede reservation and must not consume it) is exercised VERBATIM by Layer 1 cases 11-12; (c) therefore case4@A10a := A10c-equivalent and case4@A10b := A10d-equivalent, and A10a/A10b labels are topology-comparability only — mechanically identical for this candidate, no between-mode divergence observed; (d) rejected slots carry zero signer calls by construction (verified per session: signer_call_count == committed slots in all 10 sessions); (e) gist header says 'Node 22', executed on node v24.22.2 — Layer 1 passed 12/12 on Node 24, recorded as the appendix deviation, no engine errors

Result: the pinned gist pre-sign owner fence satisfies the pre-registered matrix on ALL rows — identical concurrent offers admit exactly one signature ('held'), conflicting offers under one purchase_id admit exactly one commitment + one explicit pre-signer rejection ('conflict'), separate accounts and distinct purchase ids continue to sign independently (no over-blocking); the fence also retains state through pre-sign failures and lost replies (Layer 1 cases 7-10) and never lets a refused over-cap offer consume the reservation (Layer 1 cases 11-12). Signer-call deltas 8-10 ms across race sessions (baseline band 7-9 ms). Both pre-registered candidates of x402 #4198 (boundra fb09284 -> argus-seal-0018, gist df69c25 -> this record) PASS the same matrix on the same harness perimeter; verdicts are claims about the CANDIDATES' boundaries vs the pre-registered matrix, not about the x402 protocol or the #4198 baseline client (which still exhibits the F-A10 identical-offer race per argus-seal-0008/0012)

Out of scope (boundary, not PASS/FAIL): post-sign ambiguity reconciliation (#4094 lost-reply class — exercised verbatim by Layer 1 cases 7-8: 'unresolved' + later 'held'), facilitator-side dedup, cross-process without a shared owner, DO-backed reservation door (wave 2, cv-scvd). Evidence discipline: signer-boundary observability (presign_decide=rejected + slot_error, signer untouched) or signing (signer_call); NO on-chain transfer established (settlement mocked); no private keys, no signatures, no usable authorizations in evidence; session event ledgers + sidecar decision logs + per-session fence state + the Layer-1 verbatim run log exported to attestations/evidence/0019-gist-a10/ with export-hashes.json. Verdict taxonomy: PASS = observed behavior satisfies the pre-registered matrix row (winner-agnostic matchers: totals only, winning slot/amount logged verbatim, never asserted); FAIL = conformance gap; HARNESS_ERROR would be recorded as such.
